decisions.reason: BA shorthand cannot be mapped safely to Business Administration or Business Analytics. Official 2026-27 school catalog lists both business administration programs and business systems/analytics programs; no named operations unit verified.

sources.note: University identity and School of Business overview plus Departments/Programs tab; university lists Arts and Sciences, Business, Nursing and Health Sciences schools.
Finance and Analytics overview and faculty tab checked; no separately named operations group.
Management department goals concern leadership, supervision, international business and marketing; no named operations unit.
Nonbusiness school and department inventory reviewed; no industrial engineering department listed.

limitations: BA shorthand remains unresolved between business administration and business analytics; examined official school/department structure supports neither as a named operations unit. No claim that operations coursework or individual researchers are absent.
